subtopic_title: Identification and properties of angles at a point and angles on a straight line
curriculum_objective_text: Identify angles at a point and angles on a straight line and state their properties
text: State the properties of angles on a straight line.

record_links.rationale: This definition states that supplementary angles add up to 180 degrees and connects that property to adjacent angles on a straight line.

heading_path.h2: 15.2 Angles on straight and intersecting lines

record.evidence_quote: **supplementary angles** Two (or more) angles are supplementary if they add up to $180^{\circ}$. **adjacent angles** Adjacent angles are next to each other. Two adjacent angles share the same vertex and a common arm.
record.content_text:
**supplementary angles** Two (or more) angles are supplementary if they add up to $180^{\circ}$.

**adjacent angles** Adjacent angles are next to each other. Two adjacent angles share the same vertex and a common arm.

closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.proposed_objective_text: Calculate unknown angles on a straight line.
closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.evidence_quote: The angles must have a sum of $180^{\circ}$, because they form a straight line.
closest_candidate_atomic_objectives.rationale: The textbook includes a worked example and repeated exercises where learners use the straight-line angle property to compute unknown angle values. That is measurable and more specific than the canonical identify/state AOs.
